issue.title: sase-research-artifacts 0.3.0 cannot publish: published-minimum smoke pins sase==0.17.2, a version sase will never release
issue.description:
Found by the sase-1e3 land agent on 2026-10-01 while checking the release phase (sase-1e3.11), which proposed merging the sase-research-artifacts release PR. This was not caused by sase-1e3: the sase>=0.17.2 floor predates the epic (pyproject comment, c9f41f3 and earlier).

Release PR #2 (`chore(master): release 0.3.0`) merged, and tag v0.3.0 plus its GitHub release exist. PyPI still shows 0.2.0, because Publish run 36936311149 failed in `install-smoke-published-minimum`:

    uv pip install ... "sase==0.17.2" "sase-core-rs==0.35.0" dist/*.whl
    error: Because there is no version of sase==0.17.2 ...

Root cause: pyproject.toml declares `sase>=0.17.2`. The published-minimum smoke (publish.yml:166/179) and tests/test_ci_install_contract.py:21 (`PUBLISHED_MINIMUM_SASE = "sase==0.17.2"`) pin that version exactly. But sase's manifest is 0.17.1 and its pending release-please PR (#299) is `release 0.18.0`, so sase 0.17.2 will never exist on PyPI. This publish lane is therefore unpublishable by construction, not just waiting on a release.

Remedy: move the floor, the published-minimum pins, and the contract test to the sase version that actually ships next (0.18.0, once sase-16p's release lands). Then publish the plugin, either through a new release PR or with the `publish_existing` workflow_dispatch on v0.3.0 once the pins resolve. This includes the #research/audio xprompt and the research_swarm audio stage from sase-1e3.9.
